value.rationale: The recent nilpotent-product-probability statistic naturally asks for multiple products in noncommutative full matrix rings. A previously established t=2 rectangular formula does not determine products of three or more random matrices because their prefix is highly nonuniform and has a nontrivial rank distribution. The theorem supplies a complete all-length, all-dimension, all-field exact law without calculating any intermediate rank distribution; the invariance under reordering dimensions is structurally informative, and long products exhibit an exact geometric dependence on length. The result is not an arbitrarily selected small finite case or a claimed improvement to the known two-factor result.
